witness.text:

comparisons.rationale: A married couple earning $145,000 with two children pays about $10,400 federal income tax (2025 brackets, $31,500 standard deduction, two $2,200 child credits); even with no credits it is $14,800. Twenty percent of $10,400 is about $2,100, not "about six grand". The spoken $30,000 is close to total federal taxes once both halves of payroll tax are added (income tax $10,398 + employee FICA $11,092 + employer FICA = about $32,600), so the figure may be a payroll-inclusive total mislabelled as "income tax"; on that reading 20% is about $6,500, but the 20% interest share applies to all federal receipts.

strengths: Strong cold open and a clear four-exit structure with real BUT/THEREFORE logic.
Contrarian reading of falling foreign ownership.
Several market figures reproduce exactly (30-year yield, mortgage rate, dated debt).
weaknesses: Household examples carry the most visible numerical errors, in the section meant to make the stakes personal.
Title and thumbnail promise a discrete collapse the script disclaims.
No call to action; a spoken "Quick re-hook" cue appears in the text.
contradictions: "Imploded" and an exploding chart versus "went off in slow motion".
"Roughly 30,000" tax versus the same couple's $145,000 income.
"Up over 25% since the start of last year" versus 2025 alone.
"Door is mostly locked" (door two) versus "three of the four exits are locked".
"225 tons of gold ... more than the entire gold reserves of Switzerland" (Switzerland holds about 1,040 tonnes by analyst recall).
improvement_opportunities: Recompute the Phoenix couple (about $10,400 tax, about $2,100 to interest) and state the share as an average attribution; this is the most re-quotable number in the video.
Retitle toward what the video delivers: "The US Now Pays More On Interest Than On Its Military - What Happens Next" keeps the stakes without a collapse event.
Put the thumbnail text at the interest-above-military fact instead of "IT STARTED..." so the visual states the payoff.
Move the household section (mortgage, Social Security) before the Ferguson history so the personal stake arrives by ~5,000 characters instead of ~12,900.
Add a closing ask tied to the content (check I bond limits this week) and an on-screen source line for the 5.19% yield and the $970B interest figure.
